title: Oyatie Cloud resource-contract parity catalog companion for hyperscaler backend categories
purpose: Expands the G001 taxonomy into machine-readable resource contracts that every cloud-* resource category must satisfy before future parity or operational claims can be evaluated.

can_claim_now: Oyatie Cloud has a proposed machine-readable resource-contract coverage map for the G001 backend categories.
Every listed resource contract carries ORN, lifecycle, quota, billing, audit, tenant/account/project, region/cell, owner, deletion-retention, and SLO facets.

nonclaims.statement: No resource contract in this catalog provisions external or internal live resources.
The catalog maps target resource contracts; behavior equivalence to AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or OCI is blocked until later evidence exists.
Measured production-quality evidence is deferred to later ultragoal stories before any launch language is allowed.
Tenant or product workload migration remains blocked until later gates are green.
SLO tier fields are metadata only until burn-rate and incident evidence exist.

doubt_driven_review.challenge: A resource catalog can look like implemented cloud inventory.
doubt_driven_review.resolution: Every contract is marked metadata_only/adapter_boundary/evidence_required, carries blocked claim families, and validator rejects live apply markers or readiness/parity wording in can-claim fields.
doubt_driven_review.residual_risk: G003-G007 must still implement and measure operations, policy, SLO, quality-kit, and dogfood CI evidence before any runtime claim is safe.
